title: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020
versionLabel: Industrial Relations Code, 2020, as amended by the Industrial Relations Code (Amendment) Act, 2026
text:
72. Re-employment of retrenched worker.—Where any worker is retrenched and the employer
proposes to take into his employment any person within one year of such retrenchment, he shall, in such
manner as may be prescribed, give an opportunity to the retrenched workers who are citizens of India
to offer themselves for re-employment and such retrenched workers who offer themselves for re-
employment shall have preference over other persons.
